fact_pattern: Jurisdiction X: GloBE Income = EUR 10,000,000, Adjusted Covered Taxes = EUR 1,000,000, SBIE = EUR 500,000, Additional Current Top-up Tax = EUR 0
computation: Step1 ETR = Adjusted Covered Taxes / GloBE Income = 1,000,000 / 10,000,000 = 0.10 = 10%. Step2 Top-up Percentage = 15% - ETR = 15% - 10% = 5% (floored at 0%). Step3 Excess Profit = GloBE Income - SBIE = 10,000,000 - 500,000 = 9,500,000. Step4 Jurisdictional Top-up Tax = Excess Profit * Top-up % + Additional = 9,500,000 * 0.05 + 0 = 475,000.
result: ETR 10%, Top-up Percentage 5%, Jurisdictional Top-up Tax EUR 475,000 before allocation to CEs
weakest_point: SBIE amount assumed as EUR 500k for illustration; real SBIE would depend on payroll/tangible asset percentages for that year

fact_pattern: Fiscal year beginning in 2023: Eligible payroll costs = EUR 20,000,000, Eligible tangible assets carrying value = EUR 100,000,000, Transitional rates FY2023: payroll 10%, tangible 8%
result: SBIE for FY2023 = EUR 10,000,000 to be subtracted from Net GloBE Income to get Excess Profit
weakest_point: Transitional schedule after 2023 declines annually to 5% each by FY2033; exact yearly 0.2pp steps may vary per Administrative Guidance version

fact_pattern: Three-year averages: FY2022 Revenue EUR 8,000,000 Income EUR 800,000, FY2023 Revenue EUR 9,000,000 Income EUR 900,000, FY2024 Revenue EUR 8,500,000 Income EUR 700,000
result: De minimis exclusion applies; Top-up Tax for jurisdiction deemed zero for FY2024 (annual election)
weakest_point: Uses EUR thresholds directly; official test uses Average GloBE Revenue and GloBE Income computed under GloBE rules which may include adjustments not shown here
